source.notes: Genuine ICSE 2023 board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (official ZIP bundle). No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Maximum Marks 80, Time allowed Two hours (plus 15 minutes reading time). Section A (40 marks) is compulsory: Question 1 has fifteen 1-mark MCQs (marks from the [15] bracket), Questions 2 and 3 carry marks printed per sub-part. Section B prints 'Attempt any four questions from this Section' and offers six 10-mark questions (4-9); all six are extracted, so the pack's marks total (100) intentionally exceeds maxMarks (80). Sub-parts are split at the level where marks are printed ((i), (ii), (iii)); their own (a)/(b)/(c) items stay together in the text unless noted. No internal 'OR' choices are printed, so choiceGroup is null throughout. Figures, diagrams and circuit diagrams are not reproduced. Paper code 'T23 521' printed in the footer. The paper states 'This Paper consists of 11 printed pages and 1 blank page'; the PDF has 11 pages (the blank page is not included), and PDF page numbers equal the printed page numbers. Question 2(i) combines a radioactivity item (a) with two pulley items (b)-(c) under one [3]; it was split into three 1-mark entries (split not printed; flagged). Q1(iii) prints options (a) and (d) identically ('magnetic to electrical'); kept as printed. Degree signs, powers and nuclear-equation numbers printed as raised/lowered characters were rebuilt as Unicode and flagged.
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.
